Customer: Hi, I'm following up on the 'Lesson Sync Failed' error (Code 409) from last Tuesday. Your team pushed a fix yesterday, and I can confirm the sync is working perfectly now on my iPad. The app seems stable otherwise, though my executive mentioned the interface feels slightly sluggish when loading the advanced French audio packs for offline use, but it doesn't actually crash. Just wanted to close the loop on the original error and mention that observation. Let me know if you need anything else.
Agent: Thanks for the update regarding the sync fix. Regarding the sluggishness you mentioned, could you specify if this is preventing any specific tasks from completing or if you are reporting a general performance concern?
